messages:
Priya: Heads-up — ACME pilot asked to move their private-pilot launch earlier by ~2w. They need HSM/KMS integration and a hard latency SLO (p95 < 300ms). Can we triage deps and potential scope cuts today?
Alex: Do we have the expected QPS and model size for the pilot? Need those to estimate prewarm and GPU footprint.
Priya: ACME expects bursty peaks up to 120 QPS, avg 30. Model is a 13B open variant (we can propose a quantized opt). They want private VPC + HSM for key custody.
Dan: Runtime notes: 13B quantized can hit p95 if we do continuous batching + KV cache, but prewarm and consistent node count needed. Two asks: a) prewarm policy for burst days, b) model variant fallback if capacity constrained.
Tae: Infra: 120 QPS sustained bursts imply reserved slots. We can carve Dedicated capacity but need a 2-week lead to reserve GPUs and set autoscale policies. Canary windows need to be in staging (low traffic) and then prod.
Maya: Security: HSM onboarding + attestation + audit logs is non-trivial. Cert provisioning + KMS integration needs ~10 business days minimum. Also need an SOC review for customer-managed keys.
Priya: Ok — seems like HSM is the critical path. Options: 1) Keep HSM but push timeline; 2) Offer Redwood-hosted KMS with strict encryption-in-transit/at-rest + audit logs as a temporary fallback; 3) Reduce scope to smaller model (7B) with same HSM. Which is fastest?
Alex: Fastest is Redwood-hosted KMS fallback + 7B model. That reduces infra needs and avoids HSM lead time. We should capture risk statement for customer (keys not customer-managed).
Dan: From runtime POV, fallback plan: if HSM not ready, route pilot traffic to a dedicated pool using hosted KMS and a slightly smaller model. We can implement routing rule: prioritize HSM pool, fallback to hosted-kms pool. Example policy: ```
route_policy:
  - condition: customer.hsm_ready == true
    target: dedicated-hsm-pool
  - else:
    target: dedicated-hostedkms-pool
```
Tae: I can provision the hosted-kms pool in ~3 days once we lock model and slot counts. HSM-pool needs infra + security approvals.
Maya: If we go hosted KMS fallback, we'll still need an audit trail and an SLA on key access. I'll draft the customer-facing risk/controls blurb.
Priya: Action items draft (short):
- Security: Maya to confirm minimum HSM onboarding checklist and publish missing items (by EOD).
- Infra: Tae to estimate GPU slot count for 13B vs 7B and earliest reserve date (by tomorrow).
- Runtime: Dan to prototype routing policy and prewarm config (PR + perf numbers, 48h).
- Product: Priya to update pilot SOW with fallback and acceptance criteria (today).
- Ops: Alex to prepare rollback criteria and canary windows.

Can we all join a 30m sync at 3pm PT to lock owners? Link: https://docs.redwood.ai/notes/acme-pilot-onramp (please review checklist before).
eng-bot: Created ticket RDW-1234 "ACME pilot HSM/onramp gating" and scheduled 30m meeting 1769834000 (3pm PT). Assigned: Maya, Tae, Dan, Alex, Priya.
Priya: Thanks — will post the trimmed acceptance criteria in the doc and tag folks. If HSM timeline slips, we default to hosted-KMS + 7B model and notify ACME with explicit rollback plan. :thumbsup:
